128.title: Princess Mononoke
128.overview: Ashitaka, a prince of the disappearing Emishi people, is cursed by a demonized boar god and must journey to the west to find a cure. Along the way, he encounters San, a young human woman fighting to protect the forest, and Lady Eboshi, who is trying to destroy it. Ashitaka must find a way to bring balance to this conflict.

47104.title: Through the Olive Trees
47104.overview: When the actor in a scene for his film Life And Nothing More… has to quit, a film director casts another man for the part. However, complications arise since the man and the woman who was cast for the scene know each other.

399872.title: Ivan's Need
399872.overview: Ivan is in heaven. At work in a bakery, his hands knead the white dough with abandon and will soon do the same to a woman’s plump breasts. Her hunger is as limitless as his, and she possesses his body and soul.

947520.title: Mary Anning
947520.overview: England, 19th century. 12-year-old Mary is passionate about the fossils that she collects and sells with her father. When he accidentally dies near the fossil cliffs, Mary, her brother and her mother struggle to make the payments for the family house, meaning they will probably have to leave the seaside that Maëlys loves so much. But her father left a mysterious message: what was it that he saw on the cliffs before he died? With some help from her friends, Mary will fight to save her home and continue to do what she loves, searching for fossils, in the midst of a society where girls should not ​“behave like men”. Mary doesn’t know it yet, but she’s going to go down in history…

1154304.title: Buffalo Kids
1154304.overview: In 1886, orphaned Irish siblings Mary and Tom arrive in New York City via ocean liner, and quickly find themselves on a wild, cross-country journey aboard a transcontinental 'Orphan Train', where they meet an extraordinary new friend who will change their lives forever.

1168320.title: Sara
1168320.overview: Sara, a transgender woman goes back to her remote hometown to attend her father’s funeral. She finds the village has changed greatly, and that the villagers have become extremely religious. Added to that, her mother suffers from dementia and treats her like a complete stranger.
1168320.trailerName: BIFF2023 Trailer l 사라의 수난  Sara l 아시아영화의 창 / 특별기획 프로그램 - 인도네시아 영화의 르네상스

1185344.title: The Beast
1185344.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

1207936.title: Der Schimmelreiter
1207936.overview: North Friesland today: After the death of his father-in-law, Hauke Haien takes on two important roles in coastal protection - dyke count and director of coastal protection. Professionally, Hauke is the best man for the job; he is a visionary who lives and thinks in harmony with nature. Only people are not his cup of tea. As a loner, Hauke hardly knows how to inspire an audience and win over fellow campaigners. His warnings about the effects of climate change are dismissed as hysteria in the village, even though the coastal inhabitants know that a drastic change of course in climate policy is unavoidable. Fortunately for Hauke, his wife Elke supports him. She manages to make him heard. But Hauke does not enjoy his success for long, because when it becomes known that his plans are much more radical, he is met with incomprehension and anger. Resistance and pressure wear on him. Disaster can no longer be averted.

1239616.title: The Death of a Star Is Such a Beautiful Thing
1239616.overview: A dying star painted on scrap 35mm black and white film.
1239616.trailerName: The Death of a Star Is Such a Beautiful Thing (2024) - dir. Jesse Larrivée
1239616.original_title: The Death of a Star Is Such a Beautiful Thing

1248832.title: Digger
1248832.overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

1249152.title: Four Minus Three
1249152.overview: Barbara and her partner Heli are professional clowns, living out their dream of an alternative, joy filled life with their two children, laughing at what doesn't work out. But when a tragic car accident takes Heli and the children, Barbara is left alone. In the face of unspeakable loss, her belief in humor, hope, and humanity is put to the ultimate test. Can her way of seeing the world — through both its light and shadow — help her find a way back to life? She bets she'll laugh again.
1249152.trailerName: Four Minus Three - official trailer - English subtitled

1256192.title: Ari
1256192.overview: Right in the middle of a school inspector’s visit, Ari, a 27-year-old student teacher, collapses. Angry with him for being a failure, his father kicks him out of the house. Emotionally raw, and alone in the city, Ari reluctantly forces himself to rekindle his relationships with old friends. As his memories of the previous months successively ebb and flow, Ari discovers that other people aren’t doing as well as he imagined, and that perhaps he has been sleepwalking through his own life.

1263040.title: The Pride of Bharat: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
1263040.original_title: The Pride of Bharat: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj

1272128.title: Rio de Clarice
1272128.overview: Film based on five short stories by Clarice Lispector (“A Bela e a Fera”, “Amor”, “Feliz Aniversário”, “Preciosidade” e “Mal-estar de um Anjo”).

1286656.title: I Play Rocky
1286656.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

1301248.title: 2 Aile Arasında
1301248.overview: Sequel to 'In the Family' (2017). Plot TBA.

1306368.title: The Rip
1306368.overview: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

1306816.title: My Daughter Is a Zombie
1306816.overview: Jung-hwan is a gruff but loving zookeeper who specializes in training wild beasts. His teenage daughter, Soo-ah, is going through puberty and a full-blown dance obsession. Their days are full of bickering and bonding... until one day, Soo-ah becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan takes her to a quiet seaside village called Eunbong-ri, where his mother Bam-soon lives. In a world obsessed with rooting out the infected, Soo-ah shows strange signs of awareness - responding to music, her grandmother's sharp taps with a back scratcher, and even faint traces of human language. Determined to protect her at all costs, Jung-hwan draws on his years of experience training tigers and begins a secret mission to tame and retrain... his zombie daughter.

1319168.title: Youthful Grace
1319168.overview: Amir and Eliyahu, two teens living on the outskirts of Jerusalem, try to survive in a world of adult neglect. An unusual encounter on Passover Eve leads them on an unexpected journey.

1352384.title: Rio de Sangue
1352384.overview: After leading a failed operation, a policewoman under a death threat leaves São Paulo in search of safety and to reconnect with her daughter, who works as a doctor for a non-governmental organization and was kidnapped in the interior of Pará by illegal gold miners.

1368576.title: Trago Seu Amor
1368576.overview: Mia is a self-centered witch who possesses an unusual power: whoever kisses her falls in love with her or falls back in love with the last person they loved. In one of her jobs, however, she ends up falling in love with the woman she was supposed to cast a spell on.

1372160.title: God of Frogs
1372160.overview: An Anthology film about four segments surrounding the same monster. Deep in the heart of the jungle exists an elemental creature with an eternal hunger, and every 25 years, it emerges: a woman is eaten alive in 1969, a film crew goes missing in 1994, a politician explodes live on television in 2019, and a multinational corporation goes up in flames in 2044.

1373504.title: Maya Satya Bhram
1373504.overview: Two disappearances unsettle Kolkata’s Prafullanagar: Totoro, the young son of Sub-Inspector Sanjay Konar, and Sara Nilson, a Swedish researcher studying shamans. Their fates intertwine around one enigmatic man, Trilokdarshi Baba. Once known as Tilu, a boy haunted by violence and visions of death, Trilok grows into a mystic who seems to perceive the boundaries between the living and the beyond. As Sanjay’s search unfolds, the line between truth and faith begins to dissolve.
1373504.trailerName: Maya Satya Bhram (মায়া সত্য ভ্রম) | Official Trailer | Priyanka Sarkar | Soham Mojumdar | Samik RC

1384512.title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
1384512.overview: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.
1384512.trailerName: I Am Your Friend | Official Trailer | Releasing at PVR INOX on July 24

1393728.title: The Cholesterol Code
1393728.overview: In a world where 92 million Americans rely on statins as their lifeline, one man's unexpected health journey uncovers a medical mystery that could upend everything we think we know about heart health, cholesterol, and the ketogenic diet.

1399488.title: Untitled Cat Commercial
1399488.overview: A commercial for cat treats that cause lasers to shoot from the feline’s eyes to stop home invaders.

1406656.title: I Want More
1406656.overview: Marcin decides to take a risky gamble to save the life of his beloved's father. He draws his friends into a cybercrime that spirals out of control. Greed, loyalty, and love clash in a dramatic finale.

1415360.title: Children of Heaven
1415360.overview: Two siblings, Ali and Zahra, who agreed to keep the matter of Zahra's missing shoes a secret, which Ali had brought in for repair. To solve the problem, they decided to share Ali's worn-out shoes. Zahra would wear them in the morning during her school schedule, and after returning home, she would run as fast as she could so Ali could wear them to school in the afternoon. New hope emerged when Ali learned of an inter-school running competition with a prize of a pair of shoes for the third-place winner. Ali signed up, determined to win the competition so he could buy Zahra new shoes.

1425472.title: The Rescue
1425472.overview: A modern day western in which a rodeo cowboy's skills are put to the test outside the arena.

1437696.title: Fatherland
1437696.overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

1443136.title: Chennai Love Story
1443136.overview: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.
1443136.trailerName: Chennai Love Story - Official Trailer | Kiran Abbavaraam | Gouri Priya | SKN | Sai Rajesh | Ravi

1444032.title: Masthishka Maranam
1444032.overview: Plunging into a virtual reminiscence challenge to assuage his sorrow, a heartbroken dad uncovers a shocking revelation about Frida Soman, his long-admired icon and globally beloved luminary.
1444032.trailerName: Masthishka Maranam - Official Trailer | Rajisha Vijayan | Niranj Maniyanpilla Raju | Krishand|Varkey

1446080.title: The Mad Dog of Europe
1446080.overview: A documentary exploring the 1933 screenplay of the same name by Citizen Kane co-writer Herman Mankiewicz, which warned of Adolf Hitler's rise to power, but was rejected by Hollywood studios at the time.

1446912.title: A Sucker's Born Every Minute
1446912.overview: Toni, once a famous singer, now has gambling debts and struggles to make ends meet. His luck changes when Malena, a former lover, introduces him to Junior, a wealthy young man, ready to hire him to steal a priceless painting from his own mother. To carry out this supposedly easy heist, Toni recruits a clumsy crew, forming a team in which each one pursues their own interests.
1446912.trailerName: Cada día nace un listo | Teaser oficial HD

1462784.title: Life in a Beat
1462784.overview: Lena is a 20 year old woman who lives in Athens, works at a local supermarket and lives with her family.What if keeping her baby is the only way to keep her job?

1471168.title: Barreda
1471168.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.
1471168.trailerName: Barreda - Tráiler Oficial I Prime Video

1473664.title: It's All Going Very Well No Problems at All
1473664.overview: A young artist teetering on the edge of a quiet collapse, who finds solace and understanding through a profound connection with Harold, an elderly resident at the care home where she works.
1473664.original_title: It's All Going Very Well No Problems at All

1476928.title: Na Willa
1476928.overview: Willa, a six-year-old girl, believes that her little world in an alley in Surabaya is the most perfect and magical place. However, when her best friend has an accident and, one by one, her playmates begin going to school, Willa's world slowly changes and starts to feel lonelier.

1482560.title: The Bad Son
1482560.overview: Rubén, an eleven-year-old boy, lives in a rural area with his father until he suddenly disappears. In the aftermath, Rubén moves in with his grandmother, a woman he barely knows and with whom he must learn to coexist. In a setting where time seems to have stood still, their relationship gradually reveals a family history shaped by wounds passed down from one generation to the next. As Rubén grows older, he tries to understand this emotional legacy and find a way to break the cycle, confronting his past in an attempt to heal what he has inherited.

1488192.title: Magic Lamp
1488192.overview: Shy and sometimes naive schoolboy Sashka lives with his grandmother and confides his secrets to a smart speaker because he has no friends. But Sashka has a special power - faith in miracles, thanks to which he gets into a whirlpool of extraordinary events. In the company of a witty genie from a jug and a smart speaker that has come to life, Alisa, Sashka sets off on a dangerous journey across half the world to find his parents, who after a sandstorm in Uzbekistan ended up in a magical city, captive to Shah Zaman. Sashka and company will face the machinations of the evil sorcerer Yusuf, battles on flying carpets, hot air balloon trips, chases across endless steppes, crossing the desert and meeting people who are ready to help the boy find his family again.

1492288.title: La chaleur
1492288.overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

1498944.title: The Vampires of New Orleans
1498944.overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.
1498944.trailerName: The Vampires of New Orleans – Official Trailer

1506560.title: Clash of the Thundermans
1506560.overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

1507840.title: The Suffering Tenants
1507840.overview: A landlady of a suburban house and owner of a little cinema goes missing in this non-linear puzzle of a Hitchcockian chamber play, set in the mid-70s.

1509632.title: We're Nothing at All
1509632.overview: On Valentine’s Day, a double-decker bus explodes in a fiery blast, killing many and leaving charred remains, with evidence pointing to a deliberate act by two passengers, Fai and Ike, a gay couple from troubled backgrounds living on society’s margins. As retired forensic expert Lung Sir investigates, he uncovers their tragic story of abuse, homophobia, and despair, culminating in their decision to end their lives in a suicidal protest against an unjust world, leaving behind a haunting message: “On a beautiful day, we end our unbeautiful lives.”

1515392.title: Bad Day
1515392.overview: A single mom fights to keep one little promise to her daughter on the absolute worst day of her life.

1517120.title: Lost Land
1517120.overview: In the hope of reuniting with their scattered family, four-year-old Shafi and his nine-year-old sister Somira leave a Rohingya refugee camp in Bangladesh on a perilous journey to reach Malaysia.

1528000.title: Faraway Home
1528000.overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

1529024.title: How to Divorce During the War
1529024.overview: On the eve of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, a high-flying executive tells her husband she wants a divorce, forcing the couple to navigate their bitter separation amid an escalating mid-life crisis and an unfolding regional refugee emergency.

1543040.title: Le cinéma de Terry Gilliam - L’imagination au pouvoir
1543040.overview: Bandits, Bandits, Brazil, Munchausen, Twelve Monkeys, not to mention the crazy Monty Python saga... With their visual extravagance and ever-fresh originality, amplifying his vision of a humanity that is as disturbing as it is comical, his films have made history. In the same baroque, zany, but also tragic vein, Terry Gilliam's work and life merge into an adventure that borders on the epic.

1547712.title: Band Melam
1547712.overview: Giri and Raaji grew up together in a small village; their love and bonding also grew, but changing fortunes and misunderstandings drove them and their families apart. While Raaji moves ahead with her studies, Giri searches for his path through music with his village band. Life takes them in completely different directions until circumstances bring them face to face again. What really unfolds between them forms the rest of the story.

1549120.title: The Poet And The Spy
1549120.overview: In 1919 Fiume, Russian spy Beatrice navigates political turmoil while protecting poet Gabriele D’Annunzio, entangling with an intelligence chief and a WWI deserter amid Italy’s revolutionary unrest.

1549824.title: No One is Closer Than We
1549824.overview: When Li Weiyang's motorcycle crash left his girlfriend with missing front teeth, he struggled to afford implants by negotiating with the at-fault driver and insurers, upending their modest but stable life.

1559680.title: The Sandbox
1559680.overview: In Singapore, a stuntman teams up with his brother and ex-sister-in-law to keep their declining stunt school alive. Just as their dream seems about to fade, a rumour that Marvel Studios is scouting locally brings a surge of wannabe superheroes and misfits to their doorstep, convinced they’ll be whipped into crime-fighting shape.

1569664.title: Afterpiece
1569664.overview: Owen, a once prestigious and acclaimed stage director, has fallen into depression after more than a decade of creative drought. His ex-lover Su Manling comes back into his life leveraging their old romance, whereas his wife Tracy hovers on the verge of crossing the marital line. Eager to reclaim his dignity, he resolves to write, direct and perform in a brand-new play. However, while holding open auditions for the leading actress, he is powerfully drawn to amateur newcomer Hannah, slowly slipping into a dangerous grey area where stage drama intertwines with real life.

1570624.title: UKA-UKA
1570624.overview: Battling boredom, a little boy gets trapped in the boot of a car. When he gets out, he's no longer the same.

1575872.title: mentor
1575872.overview: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.

1580672.title: Mantra Muugdha
1580672.overview: A magical, musical, maddening ride where the music will unleash a thrilling adventure of a lifetime.

1588224.title: Fashion House
1588224.overview: Otto, a young man working at a Moscow fashion house, is preparing for his wedding to his fiancée, Maria. At one of the shows, he meets a teacher he had a crush on in his youth. Their feelings are rekindled. This relationship leads to a series of problems and misfortunes, culminating in a murder in the very heart of the fashion house. This story has narrators—they debate throughout the film the artistic direction of scenes, the genre, and even the color scheme of the characters' outfits. Whether it's a classic detective story, a French comedy, or surrealism in fashionable tones—the viewer will have to decide at the very end.

1589248.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
1589248.overview: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.
1589248.original_title: Mein bester Freund, seine Freundin und ich

1595328.title: Masked
1595328.overview: Masked exposes the often overlooked mental health battles of those on the Autism Spectrum. Chloe Cavelle shares her journey of learning to function in a world not built for her.

1598464.title: Down the Road Apiece
1598464.overview: A lonely ranch hand in rural West Texas decides to risk the only life he's ever known when he falls for a hard-pressed woman stranded in the nearby town. He makes up his mind to leave with her, but things don't quite work out as planned.

1604480.title: Barbara Buser – Swiss Pioneer of Sustainability
1604480.overview: The award-winning Swiss architect Barbara Buser saves buildings from demolition and rebuilds them with reused materials. She transforms former industrial sites into urban living spaces that symbolize a careful approach to our environment and to each other. As a woman who is successfully forging her own path in a male-dominated field, Barbara Buser is a role model for the younger generation, who are fighting for a more sustainable, fairer world.

1617152.title: London Ghost
1617152.overview: A woman is blindfolded and whisked away by friends for a birthday celebration. When a voice from the past resurfaces, the line between surprise and trap quickly starts to blur.

1619328.title: Bee My Love
1619328.overview: Private chef Hannah Jones, competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur, finds inspiration in her mother’s recipes, the sweetness of honey, and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to believe that life, and love, are sweetest when shared.

flatrate.name: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

1625344.title: The Rainbow Fish
1625344.overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.
1625344.trailerName: THE RAINBOW FISH | Teaser | In theaters November 19!

1627840.title: Red Zone: Dead City
1627840.overview: The city has fallen to the undead―and the lockdown begins! The nation’s only breakout zombie phenomenon returns as a feature film, reimagined on a larger scale by veteran filmmakers, plunging audiences into a relentless fight for survival in a city overrun by the infected.

1630464.title: Clarissa
1630464.overview: A modern reimagining of the Virginia Woolf novel Mrs. Dalloway. Follows society woman Clarissa as she prepares to host a party at her home in Lagos, Nigeria, where she will unexpectedly encounter once-intimate friends from her youth. As the group reflects on their shared past over the course of a single night, memories of their intricate relationships, passionate love, hidden desires, and lost aspirations give rise to bittersweet reckoning.

1631232.title: echo
1631232.overview: In a beautiful yet mysterious world reminiscent of a mother's womb. Guided by equally mysterious creatures, two twin children embark on a journey to meet the mother they have never known.
1631232.trailerName: 坂本美雨×原摩利彦『国宝』チームが音楽・主題歌を奏でる土海明日香監督作品「もし、これから生まれるのなら」予告編【TOHOシネマズ 日比谷にて3月6日(金)～3月12日(木) 1 週間限定公開】

1637120.title: Saligia
1637120.overview: After the apocalypse on Earth, seven people find themselves in an unknown space without any memories of who they are, or how they got there. One of them is convinced that they are all in her dream, from which she is trying to wake up by all means.

1637952.title: Jacky
1637952.overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

1639616.title: Zustìssia
1639616.overview: Set among the mountains of southern Sardinia, Zustissia reconstructs the 1991 triple homicide that led to Zuncheddu being sentenced to life imprisonment. He spent 33 years in prison before being definitively acquitted on 26 January 2024, following a retrial initiated by lawyer Mauro Trogu.

1649600.title: STRAIGHT EDGE
1649600.overview: Desperate to escape his dead-end life, Matt (Chris Lovejoy) recruits his derelict friends to rob the neighborhood mob's card game. With his crew's reputation on the line, Denicio (Joe Graziano) is tasked with hunting down the trio and finding the money. Matt is forced to choose between his past or a life with the woman he loves.
1649600.trailerName: STRAIGHT EDGE | Official Trailer UHD | Bloucan Productions

1658304.title: The Distance We Drift
1658304.overview: After nearly a decade apart, two former lovers from Hong Kong unexpectedly meet again in the UK, where they have each built a different life.  Their reunion brings back memories they have tried to move on from, as they slowly reconnect and begin to see how much has changed. Now living far from home, they are forced to face the distance between who they were and who they have become.  Set within the everyday reality of immigrant life, The Distance We Drift is a quiet and intimate story about love, memory, and the way time reshapes people in ways they don’t always realise.
1658304.trailerName: The Distance We Drift TEASER | 離開的我們 先導預告

1658368.title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
1658368.overview: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.
1658368.original_title: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun

1660288.title: The Comet
1660288.overview: Eight-year-old Émile is enjoying the last of the warm summer evenings with his sister Françoise. While they are eagerly scanning the night sky for shooting stars, they are suddenly interrupted by a despicably cruel act.

1660544.title: A Trip to the Ear
1660544.overview: A woman, living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris, wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

1665728.title: Fission
1665728.overview: In 1954 Germany, a nine-year-old boy discovers his father’s secret work on a nuclear device with a sinister family guest, as his fear of the Sandman resurfaces in his own act of cruelty.

1666240.title: Sitting
1666240.overview: Four friends gather for drinks. As the night deepens, reason quietly slips out of the door, and drunken madness takes its seat at the head of the table.

1677568.title: The Cage
1677568.overview: Scotty, a struggling actor who faces constant rejection, receives a role in a short film, portraying a mentally troubled man. Scotty immerses himself in drastic preparation and isolation, and he finds himself losing his authenticity, slipping into different personalities, even when the cameras aren't rolling, unable to differentiate what his true reality is.

1685248.title: Шаг назад навстречу
1685248.overview: A film journey through a nature reserve in the south of France, famous for its white wild horses and the special relationship between man and animal.

1687232.title: Дени и Мэни. В кино!
1687232.overview: When Deni, a Labrador, lands a major advertising contract and moves in with his agent, Andrey, he and his cat friend, Manny, who are used to being together, find themselves separated for the first time. Immersed in the dazzling world of show business, Deni gradually realizes that no amount of success can replace family, and that sincerity is more valuable than any contract. Meanwhile, Andrey is going through a crisis in his relationship with his fiancée, and it is Deni who helps him rediscover his faith in love.

1689728.title: Obsessively Yours
1689728.overview: A socially awkward young man finds "the one" after a chance encounter at a party.

1692416.title: A Fistful of Feathers
1692416.overview: Divorced father Borko shows up at his daughter Anja's birthday party dressed as a cowboy. After making a fatal mistake, his already fragile relationships unravel, and the line between his western fantasies and reality begins to tear.

1692736.title: SYNTAX
1692736.overview: In a futuristic world like earth, androids act, feel and appear like humans. But when Azimov, the dictator of the last remaining city, Syntax, decides to use androids for power, the humans left on this world start to view androids no longer as their equals. In a revolt, the androids aim to escape. Revyn and Ava almost break out until Ava is captured and Revyn is shot. When a scavenger reawakens Revyn in a scrapyard, he must journey far and wide, fight wasteland nomads and maintain what is left of his humanity, in hope of finding Ava.

1695360.title: Grizzly Attack
1695360.overview: Stranded at a remote cabin, a grieving family faces a relentless bear that tests their shelter and forces a final stand.
1695360.trailerName: Grizzly Attack | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1697152.title: The Prompt
1697152.overview: 'The Prompt' takes an everyday tool for some and twists it into a dystopian, inescapable nightmare...

1699904.title: Esquecendo Cacá
1699904.overview: After ruining yet another friendship, Alina finds herself tormented by the fear of eternal loneliness and decides to try to reconnect with Cacá, the only girl she never fought with.

1700544.title: Isso não é um violão
1700544.overview: The virtuoso guitarist Artur Miranda Azzi shatters the conventions of classical guitar, reinventing the instrument as a dynamic medium for avant-garde experimentation. Through six bold and innovative performances of contemporary works, Azzi dismantles traditional techniques, transforming the guitar into a living, evolving entity—one that defies expectations at every turn.

1700672.title: Footage we stumbled across
1700672.overview: A group of four friends had set out to party all night, but the night of the party one of them fell ill. The other three take to record the night so he doesn't miss out on the fun. But as the night goes on the air grows thinner. From the shadows a mysterious monster arises while the camara is still rolling. The footage was lost for years but on one cold winter day a man stumbled across it. In this found footage horror comedy parody you watch the horrifying event of what truly happened that night.

1701696.title: APART
1701696.overview: In apartheid South Africa, a forbidden friendship between two boys is tested by a life-saving act that forces them to confront the hate dividing their world.

1703744.title: Gauthali
1703744.overview: Child bride Gauthali overcomes abuse, loss, and discrimination through the power of education. Her determination to reclaim her future challenges deep-rooted traditions inspiring to stand against gender inequality.
1703744.trailerName: GAUTHALI || Movie Official Trailer 2026 || Arun Chhetri, Simran Khadka, Madan Krishna Shrestha

1704256.title: Play It Cool
1704256.overview: An unreleased Micah Land film. To release sometime in 2026.  After 13-year-old Sam knocks out the town’s golden boy, Teddy Jacobs, with a perfectly aimed Pink Lady apple, he and his best friend Jim discover the horrifying truth: Teddy has no pulse. Terrified of shutting down the town, the duo embark on a chaotic, ultra-low-budget Weekend at Bernie’s routine to mask the crime until Wednesday. Dragging a increasingly smelly corpse through 7-Eleven runs, abandoned Brisbane mansions, and local parks, they must navigate rogue, racist squatters, accidental hallucinogenic Monster energy drinks, and a complete inability to act normal.

1705152.title: In search of the Griffin
1705152.overview: It seems to me that the image of the griffin in my film represents something mythical, something ancient that once existed but which we have forgotten how to see and believe in. In this sense, the Griffin stands on the same level as the myth of Revolution and Love. And I would like to prove to everyone, just as I proved the existence of the Griffin in my dream, that true love and revolution—a change in the world order—are still possible despite the challenges ahead.

1707584.title: First Napkin
1707584.overview: A monitored murderer celebrates however she can.

1708224.title: Hen Don't
1708224.overview: A late night hen party spirals out of control when the bride's older sister and the maid of honour have conflicting ideas of how the bride should celebrate her last night of freedom.

1709952.title: Flower Power - Dutch Women Painters of the 17th Century
1709952.overview: In the 17th century, advances in the natural sciences and the invention of the telescope led Dutch women painters to closely study nature and include reptiles and insects in their art. Women such as Maria Sibylla Merian, Alida Withoos and Maria Moninckx advanced botany and zoology with their highly detailed paintings. Almost forgotten, now their works hang in many important museums around the world.

1710528.title: Lali: Live at River Plate 2026
1710528.overview: Lali, one of the leading voices of Latin pop, takes over the legendary River Plate Stadium for the grand finale of her "No Vayas a Atender Cuando el Demonio Llama" tour. Filmed during the second of two sold-out nights, this electrifying concert showcases her unmatched stage presence, powerful performances, and the deep bond she shares with thousands of fans. A historic celebration of music, passion, and the evolution of an artist at the peak of her career.

1711104.title: Agatha
1711104.overview: A murdered victim of abuse returns to take revenge on humanity, drawn toward a young man whose troubled psyche may draw more similarites to the dead than he first thought.

1711424.title: Chronicle of Tiredness
1711424.overview: The land belongs to those who work it. But what about houses, homes, the place where one can rest and start a family? Image and sound unfold the history of the underlying structures that turn the right to a home into a tool of control, exploitation or dispossession.

1711808.title: Grin
1711808.overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

1714880.title: She Saw Us

1715584.title: Saul Goodman America’s 250th

1716032.title: After shift

As he revisits moments of love, regret, and loss, he becomes consumed by the desire to rewrite the past and prevent the tragedy that separated them. But when the boundary between memory and reality disappears, László must finally accept that some things cannot be changed — only cherished, mourned, and released.

1716288.title: Emmy Blotnick: What's Her Secret?
1716288.overview: In the follow-up to her critically acclaimed album PARTY NIGHTS, Emmy Blotnick returns to the stage of Brooklyn’s Union Hall with absurd yet relatable takes on marriage, dogs, and getting lost in Sephora. Crack open a fresh jar of Jennifer Lopez-brand butt cream and enjoy Emmy Blotnick’s latest special WHAT’S HER SECRET?

1721088.title: Chimera

1721408.overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

1721856.title: Ray

1721920.title: Corduroy Plants
1721920.overview: As time explodes, it leaves Debris. Check it out. The new film 'Corduroy Plants.  (C) 2026 Shakey Pictures, Inc.

1722304.title: Psalms and Lamentations
1722304.overview: Psalms and Lamentations is a short film depicting the depth of pain and grief that we so often find in life caused by the struggle of sin, along with, how that relates to our walk with God. Much of the script is derived from the books, Psalms, lamentations, Job, Johna and other books of the Bible. It is unlike most films in that it exist to relate to the pain and not to the joy in our lives. This provides a very unique viewing experience. Some people find this film extremely deep and moving while others can see the depth but don't feel it as much. Much of how deep it is for someone is hevaly determined by what someone's self talk sounds like.  Film available on YouTube

1723008.title: Selvi
1723008.overview: After her best friend Kavitha’s sudden collapse, Selvi, a home care nurse, takes on her shifts in addition to her own, determined to hold everything together. Moving from one house to another, she spends her days caring for the elderly, rarely stopping to rest. As the long hours blur the boundaries between care and exhaustion, Selvi begins to confront the weight of guilt, love, and survival.
1723008.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 셀비 Selvi | 비전 - 아시아

1724608.title: The Architect Who Built His Own Collapse
1724608.overview: When a former activist-turned-architect joins a redevelopment project led by his old comrade, now the city mayor, he finds himself wandering through a landscape of demolition, as memory, reality, and the ideals they once shared begin to collapse.

1725184.title: Dopehead
1725184.overview: After being Kidnapped from his home, Phoenix finds he is the chosen one, who will be sacrificed to the Sun.

1725568.overview: In the waiting room of a hospital's Cardiac Care Unit, two strangers, Sophia and Emilio, await word about their respective loved ones in surgery. Seeing Sophia is near panic, Emilio starts a conversation about topics innocuous (incompetent winking, the meaning of corniness) and profound (life's journey). In the process they make a connection that will forever alter the course of both of their lives.

1727936.title: Amaretti
1727936.overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

1728704.title: Siping
1728704.overview: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.
1728704.trailerName: SIPING Official Trailer | World Premiere this JULY 10 only on VMX

1729536.overview: Inspired by the filmography and thought of the filmmaker Cecelia Condit, "cecelia" is an experimental short film that follows the hazy memories that torment the protagonist as an alter ego guides her toward a painful truth.

1729728.title: Harila - Nådeløse fjell
1729728.overview: Kristin Harila and Tenjen Lama Sherpa, two underdogs from Vadsø and Nepal, climb the world's 14 highest mountains in record time. They make history – before encountering massive opposition.

1730112.title: Mr. Setback
1730112.overview: A young couple, Layla and Pedro, prepare to meet Layla's parents for dinner. Pedro's anxiety about making a good impression leads him to procrastinate at every step.

1731008.title: Hellbox IV - The Key Of Evil
1731008.overview: The key of evil is forged in hell, and a demon escapes with it, asking for help from the former priest Rodrigo, what he doesn't know is that the devil's bounty hunter is coming for the search, with all the forces of darkness with him.

1731072.overview: Strangers Arun and Tam meet on a rooftop the night they both intend to end their lives. When Arun suggests they spend the night together instead, just until sunrise, they embark on an unexpected journey through the city.

1733440.title: The True Spirit
1733440.overview: The story begins with the boxing lives of two urban Indigenous youths, Liu Li-Chen and Su Jing-Wen. Gifted with exceptional talent, Li-Chen won a national championship in junior high school, only to fall into confusion after entering high school—caught between boxing, academic expectations, and his Indigenous identity. As he struggles to find his path, his performance in the ring declines, dealing a heavy blow to his confidence. Jing-Wen, from the Nanjing Indigenous community in Sanxia, New Taipei City, is seen as a promising Olympic boxer of her generation. Yet deep down, she is uncertain about her future in boxing. The only reason she continues training is the weight of others’ expectations. Despite growing up in an urban Indigenous community, she finds no real sense of belonging in the city.

1733504.title: Mozart: The Magic Flute @  Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
1733504.overview: For years, *The Magic Flute* has been one of the most frequently performed operas at the Aix-en-Provence Festival. After an eight-year absence, Mozart’s work is now back on the programme. Clément Cogitore interprets the plot as a modern coming-of-age story: Tamino and Pamina leave the world of childhood behind and enter a reality in which beauty is fragile and truth is uncertain.

1736000.title: North Melbourne Cheer Squad
1736000.overview: Members of the North Melbourne Football Club Cheer Squad prepare to face longstanding rivals Essendon: a club they haven’t beaten in a decade.

1736576.title: The Sound of Us Fading
1736576.overview: A quiet, introverted teenage boy records small sounds because he seems afraid to forget. When he meets Mara, a mysterious girl that is interested in his strange hobby, he slowly discovers more about Mara and about himself.

1737280.title: The Cold Tremor Experiment
1737280.overview: Five people receive an invitation to a special game show.

1737920.title: The Fuet Awakens
1737920.overview: Lucas breaks the silence of the early morning in search of something to satisfy his hunger; what seems like a harmless act sets off an odyssey filled with determination and unexpected rivals.

1739200.title: Случилась жизнь: Однажды в театре Эстрады
1739200.overview: The amazing story of the musical "Boston Waltz," based on the hits of Alexander Rosenbaum. Behind "Boston Waltz," the musical is a vast creative undertaking, in which every scene, every rehearsal, and every decision recreates a plot woven from the meanings of Alexander Yakovlevich Rosenbaum's songs. A film about the making of the production shows how a powerful, emotional, and truly vibrant theatrical event emerges from thousands of individual fragments, resonating with audiences.

1741184.title: Dialogue of Energies
1741184.overview: On a single roll of Ektachrome, a pendulum swings in opposing directions over past and present forms of currency. A mirror turns inward, reflecting and refracting back.

1743296.title: Cannelloni
1743296.overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

1744512.title: The Brook
1744512.overview: Moving to the village of his mother’s youth, art student Jacob discovers his grandad’s old video camera shows one hour into the past. In Elmbrook, a place steeped in strange folklore and whispered legends, the community believe their village is protected by a puma that watches over the “good.” But when one of the good locals mysteriously vanishes, Jacob and his friends, armed with the video camera, uncover clues that pull them deeper into Elmbrook’s bizarre secrets. Soon the search for answers spirals into a dangerous mystery as they uncover a vengeful serial killer with a connection to the past.

1745088.title: Bitter Sweet

1745152.title: Above

1745216.title: Life with Omar And Uma

1745280.title: Цепенеющий лох
1745280.overview: At a provincial film festival, a young director who unexpectedly wins the top prize spends one absurd night with his friends. While everyone around him is discussing the award, drinking, falling in love, arguing about the coolness of the Husky, waking up the plane, the main character gradually understands that the real value of this night is not the victory or the movie, but random intimacy with a person.

1746176.title: Dementium
1746176.overview: Wyatt Bailey retreats to a secluded cabin to solve his mother’s murder. After taking DMT to confront his dead father, he’s torn between visions of his ex-girlfriend offering hope and a witch urging destruction in a battle for his soul.

1746496.title: B for Boys
1746496.overview: In a basement-turned boy cave, a band rehearsal spirals into chaos as creative tensions and personal drama push four teenage musicians to the brink.

1747328.title: Danny and the Hippopotamus
1747328.overview: After a disastrous date leaves Danny’s confidence at an all-time low, an old friend unexpectedly reappears in his life with one goal: to help him find his confidence again and finally work up the courage to ask out the girl of his dreams.

1748992.title: Я всё реже слышу твой голос
1748992.overview: The last days of summer. Between friendship, love, and impending changes, Lera becomes increasingly lost in her own feelings. As time passes, only fragments of memories remain of this summer.

1750528.title: Magic
1750528.overview: Adèle attends her high school reunion. Adèle has lost weight. She comes face to face with those who never appreciated her. She is transformed, like a magic trick revealed in broad daylight.

1750592.title: Without Iraj
1750592.overview: An archival documentary exploring the life and work of Iranian photographer Iraj Ganjei through a rediscovered collection of photographs, letters, and other personal documents. As the filmmakers trace the origins of an unidentified photographic archive, they gradually uncover the world of a largely forgotten photographer and his connections to the artistic milieu of 1960s Iran.

1751936.title: Um Passeio
1751936.overview: Célia, 70, decides to allow herself something she hadn't done in a long time: an outing.

Sun-drenched memories of unconditional friendship and his deep bond with Kyra flicker against the quiet of his current world, weaving a poignant meditation on friendship, masculinity and the soft marks that time leaves behind.

1754624.title: Vespers
1754624.overview: Adrift after her Unitarian Universalist church is firebombed, a Midwestern woman attempts to welcome two promoters renting out the congregation’s basement for a DIY punk gig.

1760576.trailerName: Papa Ka School | Zakir Khan | Papa Yaar | Netflix India

1768768.overview: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

1772992.title: Moon Cycle
1772992.overview: A rarely told queer love story from Indian mythology on Ila and Sudyumna, a being whose identity shifts with the phases of the moon.
